steps.text: The BISHOP moves diagonally — any distance — but never in a straight line and never over other pieces.

steps.prompt: Slide your bishop up the diagonal to h8.
steps.retryText: Remember, bishops only move diagonally. Try sliding to h8.

steps.prompt: Now slide the other way, up to a7.
steps.retryText: Try sliding diagonally the other direction, to a7.

steps.prompt: Capture the pawn on g7 using your bishop's diagonal.
steps.retryText: The pawn on g7 is on your diagonal — slide up to capture it.

steps.text: Bishops always stay on the same color square as they started — one bishop lives on light squares, the other on dark squares. Next: the mighty queen!
